title: REQ · Game store exposes focusedObjectId defaulting to null
summary: focusedObjectId field exists on the game store with default null
description: Context: GameStoreState has no focus field. Desired behavior: GameStoreState declares focusedObjectId: string | null and the store initializes it to null. Expected result: reading it on a fresh store returns null and init/setState do not alter it. Why: gives consumers a defined focus value before any key press.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fresh store, when focusedObjectId is read, then it is null
Given init is called with a GameState, when focusedObjectId is read, then it is still null
definition_of_done: Field typed and defaulted to null
